name: When should you hire a professional for bathroom drywall repair instead of doing it yourself?

mainEntity.name: When should you hire a professional for bathroom drywall repair instead of doing it yourself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need a bathroom drywall professional when damage involves plumbing leaks, ceiling sagging, shower tile boundaries, or areas larger than a few inches. DIY patch kits work well for small screw holes, but large cutouts or moisture issues require precise stud backing, proper tape embedding, and specialty moisture-resistant materials. Ceilings and areas around exhaust fans are particularly tricky to patch flat without professional feathering and texture tools. A professional also checks that framing behind the damaged drywall is structurally sound and completely dry before closing the wall, preventing recurrent mold issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a professional if the damage spans more than a few inches, involves plumbing leaks, affects ceilings, or touches tile, ensuring structural soundness and an invisible seam.
